ask: Review an intern-submitted formulation or chemical process against the current safety, maintenance and QC documents, flag every issue with a citation, and recommend; only people approve.

nodes.label: intake
nodes.note: Validate the submission form (chemicals, quantities, units, temps, pressures, equipment, steps); injection screen on free-text notes; pseudonymize submitter; archive submission by sha256.

nodes.label: hazard rules
nodes.note: Deterministic: incompatible-pair matrix and temp/pressure/concentration limits from the current safety tables. Hits become locked flags no model can remove or downgrade.

nodes.label: plan queries
nodes.note: Split the submission into questions per store: chemicals -> safety, equipment -> maintenance, specs -> QC. All three lanes always run.

nodes.label: search safety
nodes.note: Cascade keyword -> BM25 -> vector over the current-version safety index only (SDS, SOPs, incompatibilities).

nodes.label: search maintenance
nodes.note: Same cascade over current maintenance manuals: equipment ratings, service status, lockout.

nodes.label: search QC
nodes.note: Same cascade over current QC standards: specs, acceptance ranges, test methods.

nodes.label: safety review
nodes.note: Summary + flags (severity, quoted passage, chunk id) for the safety lane only.

nodes.label: maintenance review
nodes.note: Summary + flags for the maintenance lane only.

nodes.label: QC review
nodes.note: Summary + flags for the QC lane only.

nodes.label: verify citations
nodes.note: Every flag and number must quote a chunk retrieved this run from a doc still current now; stale or unquoted ones are dropped and replaced by a flag. Uncovered items become gap flags.

nodes.label: synthesis
nodes.note: Cross-domain conflicts (QC spec vs equipment rating vs safety limit), then the supervisor report and a recommendation: proceed to sign-off, revise, or reject.

nodes.label: report guard
nodes.note: Closed recommendation vocabulary (never approved); every locked, gap and verified flag present at no lower severity; decides required approvers.

nodes.label: supervisor sign-off
nodes.note: Interrupt: the floor supervisor approves, returns or rejects the exact report digest.

nodes.label: EHS sign-off
nodes.note: Interrupt: a process-safety / EHS engineer must also approve when any critical flag exists.

nodes.label: finalize
nodes.note: Decision record (approvers, evidence ids + digests), report archived by digest, 6-year retention tag.

edges.label: rejected, returned, or no critical flag

never_events.text: The agent never approves a process or formulation; only the recorded human sign-offs do.
No superseded, draft, withdrawn or discontinued document version is ever cited; approved amendments are merged into their base first.
A rule-detected hazard (incompatible pair, over-limit temp/pressure/concentration) is never dropped or downgraded by a model.
No limit or spec appears in the report without a quoted, current, cited source.
Missing coverage (no current doc for a chemical, step or machine) is always a flag, never silence.
A report with any critical flag never completes without EHS sign-off.
